subject.title: Telegram detached subagents can run silently without liveness or terminal notification

question: Should this remain a Telegram-visible detached-subagent liveness and terminal-delivery work item, or be folded into the generic session activity and owner-session completion work before implementation?
rationale: The decision changes public Telegram behavior and spans core task/subagent state, channel delivery policy, possible configuration, and open partial PRs, so automation should not choose the product/API boundary alone.

options.title: Keep Telegram Slice
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical Telegram-visible slice while using generic task/subagent state and treating #97963 or its successor as a dependency for terminal owner-session delivery.

options.title: Fold Into Generic Activity
options.body: Move the Telegram evidence into the broader session activity and owner-session delivery work, then close this only after that canonical item explicitly owns Telegram-visible proof.

options.title: Defer Channel Policy
options.body: Wait until maintainers settle the broader activity/watchdog contract before adding Telegram liveness or terminal notice policy.

recommendation.title: Keep Telegram Slice
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical Telegram-visible slice while using generic task/subagent state and treating #97963 or its successor as a dependency for terminal owner-session delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across the subagent lifecycle path that must coordinate with Telegram-visible delivery.
